description.value: Your community has kept sacred rites and watches over the dead and went over processions for births and deaths in your settlements. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.QShgLWlfKYJO750P]{Stitch Flesh} feat even if you don’t meet its prerequisites, and you gain the formula for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.z9T4c1hXwOotsMCp]{Holy Water} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.EGhUorZhB7nV73Ev]{Unholy Water}. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks that pertain to handling the dead, such as Rituals, inspecting them, embalming them, or the like.
